title: Patents
text:
Galina Bykova, Alexander Vlasov, and Rofikul Masud.
Registered computer program, Russian Federation. Certificate No. 2024687640, 20 November 2024.
Software for processing and interpreting high-frequency electromagnetic sounding signals during horizontal wellbore drilling. It supports model parameter searches, signal calculation, and target-function evaluation using interval two-layer models, including resistivity, anisotropy, dip angle, and depth. Written in C++ for Windows 10 and later.

title: Rofikul Masud
text:
Hi, I’m Rafik.
I’m an MSc Computer Science student at the University of Bonn, a long way from Novosibirsk State University, where I finished my bachelor’s in 2025. I like teaching machines to find patterns and building models of systems too big, too slow, or too far away to poke directly.
The results are on the Publications, and the longer story is in my CV.

title: Rofikul Masud
text:
Beyond computer science
My brain won’t stay in one department. I read history and philosophy to understand how we got here, and literature to understand how it felt. Music runs underneath it all, from classical to indie rock to folk.
I speak English and Russian, and German is a work in progress. I can order coffee with confidence and argue about nothing at all.
Get in touch. I’m always up for a good conversation.
